exodus.11.p1.b1.text: I will bring upon Pharaoh and Egypt one more plague. After that, he will allow you to leave this place.

exodus.11.p1.b2.text: Now announce to the people that men and women alike should ask their neighbors for articles of silver and gold.”

exodus.11.p1.b3.text: And the LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians.

exodus.11.p1.b4.text: Moreover, Moses himself was highly regarded in Egypt by Pharaoh’s officials and by the people.

exodus.11.p2.b5.text: This is what the LORD says: ‘About midnight I will go throughout Egypt,

exodus.11.p2.b6.text: Then a great cry will go out over all the land of Egypt. Such an outcry has never been heard before and will never be heard again.

exodus.11.p2.b7.text: from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne …

exodus.11.p2.b8.text: … to the firstborn of the servant girl behind the hand mill

exodus.11.p3.b9.text: But among all the Israelites, not even a dog will snarl at man or beast.’ Then you will know that the LORD makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.

exodus.11.p3.b10.text: And all these officials of yours will come and bow before me, saying, ‘Go, you and all the people who follow you!’ After that, I will depart.”

exodus.11.p3.b11.text: And hot with anger, Moses left Pharaoh’s presence.

exodus.11.p3.b12.text: Pharaoh will not listen to you, so that My wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.
